sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2026/10/PXD079632/20260218_134613_2006_roasted_peanut_Report.setup.txt (Spectronaut settings; other species setup.txt files spot-checked for modifications)

claims.evidence: All 117 deposited RAW files each claimed once; they match the Raw File column of 2006_Metadata.csv (one entry has a stray leading space).
Sample Name column of 2006_Metadata.csv with the replicate suffix removed; one typo 'Unroasedt' normalised.
Condition column 'X Digest N'. Three independent digests of one extract per legume; mapping to 'biological' is our reading.
Replicate column; protocol states triplicate injections.

claims.value: 13 legume extracts, 12 species (roasted and unroasted peanut share Arachis hypogaea); pea written as Lathyrus oleraceus
claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms and description; lentil NCBI 3864 Lens culinaris, fenugreek 78534, white clover 3899 Trifolium repens. Lathyrus oleraceus is the current NCBITaxon label of 3888 (verified), accepted by the validator in place of Pisum sativum.
Protocol: dried legume seeds ground and extracted.

claims.value: roasted / unroasted (peanut only), not available for others
claims.evidence: Roasted vs unroasted peanut in Condition column; terms not found in NCIT/EFO (warning only).
Study compares allergen composition across legume species.
PRIDE instrument field and protocol text.
DIA with FAIMS. NT/AC form (PRIDE:0000450) rejected by validator, plain label accepted.
Spectronaut Trypsin/P, specific, 2 missed cleavages; LysC was also used in digestion but column is single-valued.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M and P (hydroxyproline), Acetyl protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: Spectronaut Pulsar settings; Hydroxyproline written as Oxidation UNIMOD:35 on P.
Protocol: reduced with TCEP, alkylated with CAA.

claims.location: comment[ms1 scan range]/[scan window lower|upper limit]/[isolation window width]
claims.evidence: Protocol: MS1 400-1000 m/z, 6 m/z isolation windows with 1 m/z overlap.

limitations: Paper (doi 10.3389/FALGY.2026.1938923) not read; PRIDE record, deposited metadata CSV and Spectronaut setup file used.
Mass tolerances are dynamic in Spectronaut (no fixed value): precursor/fragment tolerance set to not available.
Lys-C used in the digest but only Trypsin declared (single-valued column); reconcile flags this.
Developmental stage, strain/cultivar, growth condition not stated: not available.
Hydroxyproline expressed as Oxidation (UNIMOD:35) on P.
Modification and tolerance settings read from the roasted peanut Spectronaut setup file; other species setup files assumed identical (white clover and white bean spot-checked for modifications).
RAW headers were not inspected; instrument/dissociation from PRIDE protocol text.
Biological vs technical replicate assignment of 'digests' is an interpretation of the metadata CSV.
